$comment: Hand-labeled from the pinned sample source (scripts/samples.json), not from Concentrate output. Calls of test.c and tests/readme_examples.c, the programs that exercise the public API: every call whose callee is a function of this repository (the cJSON_* functions, defined in cJSON.c and declared in cJSON.h, which test.c includes; and the programs' own static functions: print_preallocated, create_objects, create_monitor, create_monitor_with_helpers, supports_full_hd) is labeled with the definition; calls into the C library (printf, strlen, malloc, free, strcmp, exit) are not labeled, so any target they get counts as a false positive. A header declaration is not a target: the call runs the definition in the source file. cJSON macros (cJSON_ArrayForEach, cJSON_SetNumberValue…) are not functions and are not labeled; the preprocessor expands them. tests/common.h includes ../cJSON.c, so its static functions (compare_double) are visible to the test programs; Unity assertion macros (TEST_ASSERT*, RUN_TEST, UNITY_BEGIN/END, defined in unity.h and unity_internals.h) are labeled with their #define.
